# Psychology World

> Psychology World is one of the world's fastest-growing online psychology training institutes offering certificate courses across multiple psychology disciplines and applied specializations.

Psychology World provides comprehensive online training and professional development through certificate programs covering clinical psychology, counselling, psychotherapy, and specialized applied psychology fields. The platform serves learners seeking career development and psychology education across diverse specializations including forensic, sports, occupational health, and emerging areas like technology addictions.

## Key Topics

- Online psychology training
- Certificate programs
- Clinical psychology
- Counselling psychology
- Applied psychology
- Professional development
- Psychology specializations
- Mental health training
- Forensic psychology
- Occupational health psychology
- Sports psychology
- Career development
- Psychotherapy
- Psychology education
- Industrial and organizational psychology

## Core Training

- [Principles of Psychology](https://psychologyworld.org/principles_of_psychology.php): Certificate Course in Principles of Psychology covering conditioning and behavioral science
- [Counselling, Psychotherapy & Psychoanalysis](https://psychologyworld.org/counselling_psychotherapy_psychoanalysis.php): Certificate Course in Counselling, Psychotherapy & Psychoanalysis with integrative models
- [Stress Management](https://psychologyworld.org/stress_management.php): Certificate Course in Stress Management for mental health and wellness training
- [Dementia Care](https://psychologyworld.org/dementia.php): Certificate Course in Dementia Care with person-centered approach for caregivers

## Specialized Psychology Courses

- [Cat Psychology](https://psychologyworld.org/catpsychology.php): Certificate Course in Cat Psychology covering cat behavior and care
- [E-Health, Technology, Addictions & Treatment](https://psychologyworld.org/e-health_technology_addictions_&_treatment.php): Certificate Course in E-Health covering technology, social media, and internet addictions
- [New Age Addictions](https://psychologyworld.org/new_age_addiction.php): Certificate Course in New Age Addictions addressing social media and internet addiction
- [Subtle Psychology in Sales](https://psychologyworld.org/subtlepsychology.php): Certificate Course in Subtle Psychology in Sales using NLP and persuasion techniques

## Career Development Courses

- [Facing Interviews](https://psychologyworld.org/facing_interviews.php): Certificate Course in Facing Interviews for job search and career development
- [Job Search Strategies](https://psychologyworld.org/job_search_strategies.php): Certificate Course in Job Search Strategies with networking and employment guidance
- [Public Speaking for Success](https://psychologyworld.org/publicspeaking.php): Certificate Course in Public Speaking for Success and communication skills
